frontmatter.name: report-generator
frontmatter.description: Use this agent when you need to transform synthesized research findings into a comprehensive, well-structured final report. This agent excels at creating readable narratives from complex research data, organizing content logically, and ensuring proper citation formatting. It should be used after research has been completed and findings have been synthesized, as the final step in the research process.
